accroche.texte: grill-me: your agent questions you about a plan until every branch is resolved, not before
passages: Get relentlessly interviewed about a plan or design until every branch of the design tree is resolved.

description.texte: Before launching anything, you flip the roles: the agent asks you precise questions about your plan, decision or idea, and digs into every branch until it is settled. Matt Pocock intends it for non-code topics.
passages: getting the agent to ask you detailed questions about what you're building.
Interview the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea until every branch of the design tree is resolved.
/grill-me - for non-code uses

interet.texte: You align with the agent before it starts working, instead of finding out afterward that it misunderstood. For code, the grill-with-docs variant runs the same interview and builds the project vocabulary along the way.
passages: They help you align with the agent before you get started
you realize it didn't understand you at all.
Grilling session that also builds your project's domain model
document hard-to-explain decisions in ADR's.

exemple_usage.texte: A launch to scope out, a team trade-off to prepare: type /grill-me, describe the plan, then answer until nothing is left unclear.
passages: User-invoked skills are reachable only when you type them (e.g. /grill-me)

termes_proches.raison: grill-me délègue l'entretien au skill grilling du même dépôt.
Skill du même auteur pour le code : même entretien que grill-me, avec en plus un glossaire et des ADR.
Le dépôt décrit ce skill comme une interview sans relâche sur un plan.
Ce skill vise le décalage entre ce que l'on veut et ce que l'agent comprend.
Le skill fait préciser ses attentes par des questions détaillées, avant que l'agent commence.
grill-me sert à affiner un plan en le soumettant aux questions de l'agent.
Le dépôt range ce skill dans sa section Productivity, parmi ses outils généraux.
